spark_open.description: A large upright bird-like creature is shown in right-facing profile standing on a small patch of ground with sparse grass and tiny purple and yellow flowers. It has a stout, ovoid body held vertically, with a rounded black head bearing a long slender dark beak and a small dark eye, a bright yellow to orange patch on the side of the neck behind the head, a white and pale yellow chest and belly with dense short shaggy plumage, and a thick covering of brown velvety-fuzzy plumage over the back, sides and the single visible flipper-like wing held against its side. The lower rear bears a short stiff black tail of pointed feathers, and the body is supported by two short thick scaly legs ending in large clawed feet resting on the ground.

meta_spark.description: A large upright flightless bird shown in side profile standing on a small patch of grass and flowers. It has a bulky teardrop-shaped body with dense white plumage on the front and chest fading to pale yellow-orange on the upper chest, and dense brown plumage on the back and sides. The head is rounded and black with a small dark eye and a long slender black pointed beak, with a bright yellow patch on the side of the neck. A long narrow brown flipper lies along the visible side of the body, and a short tuft of stiff black tail feathers projects from the rear. It stands on two short thick scaly legs ending in large three-toed clawed feet.
